name: Sorcery Points
description: Sorcery points pay for Flexible Casting and your Metamagic options. You can never hold more than the maximum for your level.
A long rest refills them all.

name: Font of Magic
description: Bonus action: swap between spell slots and sorcery points.
Make a slot: spend points to create one slot of 5th level or lower. Cost: 1st level 2 points, 2nd level 3, 3rd level 5, 4th level 6, 5th level 7.
Burn a slot: expend one slot and gain sorcery points equal to its level.

name: Sorcerous Restoration
description: When you finish a short rest, you regain 4 expended sorcery points.

name: Elemental Affinity
trigger: You cast a spell of your ancestry damage type
description: Your spells that deal your dragon ancestor's damage type get your Charisma modifier added once to the damage.
Pay 1 sorcery point and you also resist that type for 1 hour.

name: Dragon Wings
description: Grow a pair of dragon wings. You fly at a speed equal to your walking speed. They remain until you dismiss them, which also costs a bonus action.
They won't come out in armor that isn't made for them, and unsuitable clothing may be ruined.

name: Draconic Presence
description: Pay 5 sorcery points to radiate awe or fear (you choose) out to 60 ft for 1 minute. It needs your concentration, just like a concentration spell.

Each hostile creature that begins its turn in the aura makes a Wisdom save. A failure means charmed (awe) or frightened (fear) until the aura ends. A success makes that creature immune to the aura for 24 hours.

name: Tides of Chaos
uses: Once, then long rest (or after a surge)
description: Give yourself advantage on a single d20 roll: an attack, a check or a save.

After that it stays spent until you finish a long rest. The exception: if the DM triggers a Wild Magic Surge once you cast a sorcerer spell (1st level or above), you roll the surge and the feature is ready again.

name: Bend Luck
trigger: Someone else you can see rolls an attack, ability check or save
description: Twist their fate with 2 sorcery points and your reaction: roll 1d4 and add it to their roll or take it away, as you prefer.
Decide after you see their roll but before its effects happen.

name: Spell Bombardment
trigger: You roll spell damage and a die shows its highest number
description: Once per turn, when you roll spell damage and any die shows its maximum number, pick one of those dice and roll it again, adding the new roll to the damage.

name: Careful Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that makes other creatures save
description: Shield some targets from your spell. Choose up to your Charisma modifier creatures (at least 1); they pass their save automatically.

name: Distant Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a range of 5 feet or more, or touch
description: Doubles the range of a spell whose range is 5 feet or more. A touch spell instead gets a range of 30 feet.

name: Empowered Spell
trigger: You roll damage for a spell
description: Pick up to your Charisma modifier (at least 1) of the dice rolled for damage and roll them again. You must keep the new results.
It stacks with another Metamagic option used on the same casting.

name: Extended Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer
description: Doubles the duration of the spell, up to a maximum of 24 hours. Useful for buffs you want to last through a whole day.

name: Heightened Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that forces a saving throw
description: Pick one target of the spell. It rolls its first save against the spell with disadvantage.

name: Quickened Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action
description: Turns the casting time of that spell from an action into a bonus action for this casting.

name: Subtle Spell
trigger: You cast any spell
description: Cast the spell with no verbal or somatic components, so nobody hears or sees you doing it.

name: Twinned Spell
trigger: Your spell targets a single creature and its range isn't self
resource: Sorcery points equal to the spell's level (1 for a cantrip)
description: Pay 1 sorcery point per spell level (a cantrip costs 1) and the spell picks up a second target, which also has to be within its range.

name: Eyes of the Dark
resource: 2 sorcery points or a spell slot
description: From level 1 you have darkvision out to 120 ft.

From level 3 you know darkness, and it doesn't count against your sorcerer spells known. Cast it with a spell slot or by spending 2 sorcery points; when sorcery points pay for it, you can see through its darkness.

name: Strength of the Grave
trigger: Damage drops you to 0 hit points
uses: Once per long rest, after a success
description: Make a Charisma save with DC 5 + the damage you just took. If it succeeds, you are left at 1 hit point. It doesn't help against radiant damage or a critical hit.
After a successful save, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Hound of Ill Omen
description: Bonus action: spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen that hunts a target in your sight no more than 120 ft away. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 ft of that target and rolls its own initiative.

Uses the dire wolf stats (Monster Manual), with changes: it is Medium and a monstrosity, and starts with half your sorcerer level in temporary hit points. It passes through creatures and objects as difficult terrain; ending its turn inside an object costs it 5 force damage. At the start of its turn it knows where its target is, so the target can't stay hidden from it.

It heads straight for its target by the shortest route, uses its action only to attack that target, and makes opportunity attacks only against it. While the hound stays within 5 ft of its target, that creature makes saves against your spells at disadvantage.
It disappears after 5 minutes, or sooner if either it or its target hits 0 hit points.

name: Shadow Walk
description: Bonus action, while standing in dim light or darkness: teleport up to 120 ft. The destination must be an unoccupied space you can see, and it too must be dim or dark.

name: Umbral Form
description: Bonus action: spend 6 sorcery points to become a shadowy form for 1 minute. You resist all damage except force and radiant, and you can pass through creatures and objects as difficult terrain; ending your turn inside an object deals 5 force damage to you.
It ends early if you are incapacitated or die, or when you dismiss it as a bonus action.

name: Tempestuous Magic
trigger: Just before or after you cast a 1st-level or higher spell
description: Bonus action on your turn, just before or just after casting a 1st-level or higher spell: you fly up to 10 ft on gusts of air, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Heart of the Storm
trigger: You cast a lightning or thunder spell of 1st level or higher
description: You have resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

When you start casting such a spell, storm magic bursts from you: creatures you choose that you can see within 10 ft take lightning or thunder damage (your pick each time) equal to half your sorcerer level.

name: Storm Guide: Rain
description: While rain is falling, spend an action to halt it within a 20-ft-radius sphere around you.
You can end this as a bonus action.

name: Storm Guide: Wind
description: If it is windy, use a bonus action each round to set the wind's direction everywhere within 100 ft of you. It blows that way until the end of your next turn.
The wind's speed doesn't change.

name: Storm's Fury
trigger: A melee attack hits you
description: The attacker takes lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level, and makes a Strength save against your spell save DC. On a fail, it is pushed up to 20 ft straight away from you.

name: Wind Soul
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: You are immune to lightning and thunder damage and have a magical flying speed of 60 ft.
Action: pick a number of creatures no more than 30 ft away, up to 3 + your Charisma modifier. For 1 hour they can fly at 30 ft by magic, while your own flying speed falls to 30 ft.

name: Good
description: Pick good as your Divine Magic affinity and you learn cure wounds. It is a sorcerer spell for you and sits outside your number of sorcerer spells known. Should you swap it out later, its replacement must come from the cleric list.
Your Otherworldly Wings (sorcerer 14) will be eagle wings.

name: Evil
description: Pick evil as your Divine Magic affinity and you learn inflict wounds. It is a sorcerer spell for you and sits outside your number of sorcerer spells known. Should you swap it out later, its replacement must come from the cleric list.
Your Otherworldly Wings (sorcerer 14) will be bat wings.

name: Law
description: Pick law as your Divine Magic affinity and you learn bless. It is a sorcerer spell for you and sits outside your number of sorcerer spells known. Should you swap it out later, its replacement must come from the cleric list.
Your Otherworldly Wings (sorcerer 14) will be eagle wings.

name: Chaos
description: Pick chaos as your Divine Magic affinity and you learn bane. It is a sorcerer spell for you and sits outside your number of sorcerer spells known. Should you swap it out later, its replacement must come from the cleric list.
Your Otherworldly Wings (sorcerer 14) will be bat wings.

name: Neutrality
description: Pick neutrality as your Divine Magic affinity and you learn protection from evil and good. It is a sorcerer spell for you and sits outside your number of sorcerer spells known. Should you swap it out later, its replacement must come from the cleric list.
Your Otherworldly Wings (sorcerer 14) will be dragonfly wings.

name: Favored by the Gods
trigger: Your saving throw fails, or your attack roll misses
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Roll 2d4 and add the result to the total, which may turn the failure or miss into a success.

name: Empowered Healing
trigger: You or an ally within 5 ft roll dice for the hit points a spell restores
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll as many of those healing dice as you like, once. You can't do this while incapacitated.

name: Otherworldly Wings
description: Bonus action: spectral wings spread from your back, giving you a flying speed of 30 ft. They stay until you die or are incapacitated, or until you use another bonus action to dismiss them.
Your Divine Magic affinity sets their look: good or law gives eagle wings, evil or chaos gives bat wings, and neutrality gives dragonfly wings.

name: Unearthly Recovery
description: Bonus action, while you are below half your hit points: heal by half your hit point maximum.

name: Additional Sorcerer Spells
description: Adds Tasha's extra spells to the Sorcerer list, so you can learn them as sorcerer spells.
They carry an Optional tag wherever they show.

name: Magical Guidance
trigger: You fail an ability check
description: Reroll the d20. The new result stands, and it may turn the failure into a success.

name: Seeking Spell
trigger: You miss with a spell attack roll
description: Reroll the d20; you have to keep the second roll.
Allowed even when another Metamagic option is already on the same casting.

name: Transmuted Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage
description: Switch that damage to another of those six types.
